name: Appenweier (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Appenweier (the archangel Michael slaying the dragon on yellow) above the name APPENWEIER in black.
history: Municipal flag of Appenweier; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Appenweier arms — Saint Michael on yellow
